extensionDescription.message: Resize inline images and attachments with a live size selector in the compose window.

sizeTooltip.message: Combined size of inline images and image attachments, before email encoding. Other attachments and web-hosted images are not included.

updateFailed.message: Could not update the images. Sending is paused. Check your attachments and retry.

restoreFailed.message: Could not restore all originals. Sending is paused. Choose Original size and retry, or reattach the original files.

largeWarning.message: Images exceed 10 MB. Choose a smaller image size to reduce the email size.

largeMessage.message: The images in this email total $1, which exceeds 10 MB. Go back to choose a smaller image size, or continue sending.
